in_hebrew.name: Mutua
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Friend or ally
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Mutua הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Swahili language, Mutua means 'friend' or 'ally'. This name was commonly used among ancient African tribes to signify unity and companionship.

in_greek.name: Mutua
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Friend or ally
in_greek.long_meaning: Mutua είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Swahili language, Mutua means 'friend' or 'ally'. This name was commonly used among ancient African tribes to signify unity and companionship.

in_latin.name: Mutua
in_latin.meaning: mutua, meaning 'given by God' in Latin tradition, symbolizing divine gift
in_latin.long_meaning: Mutua, nomen Christianum, originem ducit ab vocabulario Hebraeo, significans 'donum Dei', 'given by God', in traditione Latina, symbolizans donum divinum
